title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Nightly Rate Card and Apartment Occupancy
content:
Every stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is billed by the night at the published nightly rate of its stay type. The nightly rate covers the furnished apartment, the included meals and the care of that stay type. The table below lists, for every stay type, the published nightly rate, whether the rate in effect on the booking date is locked for the stay, how many guests may share the apartment and the nightly fee for a second guest.

## Rate and occupancy table

| Stay type | Published nightly rate (USD per night) | Rate locked at booking | Maximum guests per apartment | Second-guest nightly fee (USD per night) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 145.00 | Yes | 2 | 45.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 239.00 | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 284.00 | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 329.00 | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 352.00 | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 398.00 | Yes | 1 | 0.00 |

## Reading the columns

- **Published nightly rate** is the rate of the stay type in US dollars for one night.
- **Rate locked at booking** answers whether the nightly rate in effect on the booking date is the rate recorded for the stay. It is "Yes" for every stay type, so each stay keeps, as its locked nightly rate, the rate published on the date it was booked.
- **Maximum guests per apartment** is the number of guests who may share the furnished apartment. Only the Independent Living Trial Stay admits a second guest; every other stay type admits one guest.
- **Second-guest nightly fee** is the nightly fee for a second guest sharing the apartment. It is 45.00 on the Independent Living Trial Stay; on the stay types that admit a single guest it is 0.00.

## Illustration (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical Independent Living Trial Stay booked for two guests sharing one apartment for four nights, at the rate shown above: each night carries the published nightly rate of 145.00 and a second-guest fee of 45.00, together 190.00 per night, and the four nights together come to 760.00.
